page.overview:
Who is Jialun?

In the previous era of the Avatar, Kyoshi had shaped bureaucratic policies to aid the poorest of the kingdom, strengthened ties between the disparate states, and drafted a constitution with the 46th Earth King. Although Kyoshi had passed away, the peace and prosperity from her Era was maintained by the Earth Sages, who had regained the trust of the people and had a reputation as wise advisors and academics. They were confident in speaking out against the Earth King, and criticized Jialun when he began to twist the kingdom's constitution for his own benefit.

Jialun also became opposed to Queen Guo Xun of Omashu, a successful subordinate monarch who was steadily expanding her power across the western Earth Kingdom. Uncaring that Guo Xun's successes also strengthened the entire Earth Kingdom, the Earth King saw her as a potential rival and plotted her destruction. In 63 BG, Jialun attempted to undermine Guo Xun by helping to orchestrate a plot between Ba Sing Se's peace minister, Pushi, and Omashu's peace minister, Huaji. The objective was to poison the citizens of Omashu through its water supply with components of the Lambak mineral, the latter stolen from the Fire Nation. Jialun desired instability so he could consolidate his power over the Earth Kingdom, potentially using Huaji as a figurehead Omashu monarch. and Ta Min exposed Jialun's plans to Guo Xun. A bitter rivalry thus began to erupt between Ba Sing Se and Omashu.

Frustrated over the continued criticism by the Earth Sages, Jialun eventually orchestrated the Night of Silenced Sages. He had the Dai Li arrest every single Earth Sage across his kingdom. The temples were closed, and those who searched for the sages ended up disappearing. Eventually, the temples reopened as Royal Learning Halls, with any remaining sages becoming Grand Lectors, tightly controlled by the crown and forced to never speak of the sages again. Avatar Roku was still a young man at this time, who had only begun his journey to master the four elements, and was in no position to respond to such an event at the time. Jialun succeeded in quashing organized outspoken internal opposition, though his actions attracted the ire of many sympathetic to the sages, including Queen Guo Xun. The monarchs of Ba Sing Se and Omashu further intensified their rivalry: both monarchs had spies in each other's courts, and both throne rooms became vipers' nests.

Following the purge of the sages, Jialun further manipulated the Earth Kingdom's political system to his benefit, and portrayed himself as incompetent, which was entirely to his design.
